findings.title: BudgetStatusCard.tsx is a second, unrelated piece of dead cost-UI code, pre-dating this feature
findings.notes: Introduced in the original Budget Enforcement merge (b0c74e2), zero references anywhere in frontend/src. Not named in requirements_analysis.md or architecture.md, so out of scope for this feature. Flagged for a future cleanup pass.

summary: Implementation matches docs/architecture.md exactly across all five tasks (T1-T5). Both architectural judgment calls (FR-3: DesignCostRow left unwired in favor of CostDisplay in the collapsed design header; FR-5: BudgetPausedLabel deleted rather than wired into WorkflowCard) were implemented exactly as specified, including the documented rationale. No new network calls introduced (NFR-1), no enforcement logic touched (NFR-2), visual consistency maintained via reuse of existing CostDisplay/FeatureCostBadge components (NFR-3), all backend changes additive (NFR-4). npm run type-check shows 6 pre-existing errors unrelated to this diff (verified against the pre-development commit). Backend tests pass including new coverage for the additive cost_total_usd field.
